title: fix(service-messaging)!: an html or mjml notification template escapes every hole for markup, and each outlet package pins its outlet list (ruling 3C)
body:
Fixes #25061
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Carries out ruling **3C** on #25040 (`6308462370`): no server-side stripping or refusal of markup in text fields; every outlet that renders a text field into HTML escapes it by context, the mail template engine by default, with a pin on the outlet list. Disclosure: the #9387 ruling (`5323310017`) applies to this PR. Fixtures are neutral markup (a bold or italic element, an ampersand, quotes), and nothing here describes a request.

## What changed

- **`@objectstack/service-messaging` (the one outlet that did not escape).** `renderNotification` rendered a `sys_notification_template` body of format `html` or `mjml` by placing each `{{ payload.x }}` value into the markup as stored. The email channel sends that string as the mail's html part, so a payload text field carrying markup characters (a display name, a record title, a comment preview) reached the recipient's mail client as markup. Each hole's value in an html or mjml body is now HTML-escaped, in element text and quoted attributes alike; the template's own markup renders as written. The subject and a `markdown` or `text` body are plain text and stay verbatim. No unescaped hole form is added (none existed, and nothing in the tree needs one); a template that needs a pre-rendered fragment uses an email template, whose renderer has one.
- **Pins, in three NEW files named by the rule** (`src/text-field-html-outlets.pin.test.ts` in each package that holds an outlet): one pin on the outlet list itself, and per-entry pins that drive the real render path.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/25061-notification-template-html-escape.md`, `@objectstack/service-messaging` minor, BREAKING (patch round 1; it was a patch before the seat ruled question 1 B).

Nothing was edited in `packages/spec`, `packages/objectql` or `packages/platform-objects`.

## Outlet census

The census is the AST walk each pin file carries: a shipped source file "touches HTML" when an identifier or a string in its CODE names `html`, or a string carries an HTML element tag (comments never count). I ran the same walk over every `domain:services` package (`packages/services/*/src`, `packages/connectors/*/src`, `packages/triggers/*/src`, `packages/plugins/*/src`) at `c10cc2a71b`, seeded by `git grep` for escaper helpers, `text/html`, `body_html` and HTML tags next to interpolation. Every hit is classified below.

| Package | File | Role | Escapes by context? |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| plugin-email | `template-engine.ts` | outlet: the engine. `renderTemplate` is the HTML face, `renderPlainTextTemplate` the plain-text faces | yes, by default, unchanged: a double-braced hole is HTML-escaped in `body_html` and verbatim in the subject and `body_text`; the triple-braced hole is the one unescaped form |
| plugin-email | `email-service.ts` | outlet: `resolveAndRenderTemplate`, behind `sendTemplate` and `renderTemplate` | yes: `body_html` goes through the HTML face |
| plugin-email | `templates/auth-templates.ts` | outlet: the built-in auth templates | yes: every text variable is double-braced; see the raw-form reading below |
| plugin-email | `index.ts`, `template-loader.ts`, `transports/smtp.ts`, `transports/resend.ts`, `transports/postmark.ts` | not an outlet: re-export, column mapping, and handing the rendered html part to the provider | n/a |
| service-messaging | `template-renderer.ts` | outlet: `renderNotification` for an html or mjml body | **was no; fixed here** |
| service-messaging | `email-channel.ts` | not an outlet: forwards the rendered html; its template arm delegates to plugin-email's engine | n/a |
| service-messaging | `objects/notification-template.object.ts` | not an outlet: declares the `format` vocabulary | n/a |
| plugin-approvals | `action-link-pages.ts` | outlet: the session-less confirm and result pages an approval link opens | yes, unchanged: every request text field goes through its escaper |
| plugin-approvals | `approval-service.ts`, `approvals-plugin.ts` | not an outlet: wrap or serve that rendered page as `text/html` | n/a |
| service-mailbox | `ingest/mail-ingest-service.ts`, `ingest/parse-message.ts`, `objects/sys-mail-message.object.ts` | not an outlet: stores the html part of INBOUND mail; renders nothing | n/a |

- **HTML exports:** none on the server. Record exports are csv, xlsx and json (`packages/rest/src/export-format.ts`). The print service renders the console's own record page in a headless browser, so the UI renders the value there; the server puts no field value into markup.
- **Integration payloads:** no builder emits HTML. Webhooks serialize JSON. `connector-slack` posts caller-authored text verbatim, in Slack's markup, not HTML. `service-sms` sends plain text. The messaging digest renders plain text.
- **Other lanes (named for the seat, not touched):** `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (host-not-found page) escapes its one value. `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts` carries an already-rendered page. One further out-of-lane HTML builder, outside ruling 3C's text-field scope, is named to the seat privately. The UI renderer lives in objectui.

## The engine's raw form, measured

- **What exists.** `plugin-email`'s engine has exactly one unescaped form, the triple-braced hole. `service-messaging`'s renderer had none (every hole was unescaped), and it still has none.
- **Who uses it.** The built-in auth templates have 20 sites: password reset, verify email, magic link, invitation accept and account-invitation set-password, times four locales. Each one names a `type: 'url'` variable inside an `href` attribute, for a link the platform minted. The only other uses are plugin-email's own tests and the authoring doc (`content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx`). `examples/app-showcase`'s authored template uses double braces only.
- **Kept, and pinned.** The built-ins keep that raw form. The new pin holds them to it: in every built-in body, each unescaped hole must name a declared url variable and sit inside an `href` attribute. Every text variable must render escaped through the real `EmailService`.

## `sys_user.name` maxLength: reading

The declaration, at base `4bf079c693`, is `Field.text`, `required`, `maxLength: 255` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts:776-781`). I measured it on a real ObjectQL with SqlDriver (in-memory sqlite) under the system context, which is the context the auth adapter writes `sys_user` with (`asAttributedSystem` in plugin-auth's `objectql-adapter.ts`). I used a scratch test that is not committed.

| write | answer |
|:--|:--|
| insert, name of 255 characters (control) | accepted, 255 stored |
| insert, name of 256 characters | refused `VALIDATION_FAILED`, field error `max_length`, constraint maxLength 255 / actual 256 |
| update an existing row's name to 256 characters | refused `VALIDATION_FAILED`; the stored value is unchanged |

**Reading:** enforced at the write seam, by the objectql write validator's bounded-string branch, which is #11875's rule (`text` is in `BOUNDED_STRING_FIELD_TYPES`). No edit is owed in `platform-objects` or `objectql`.

## Pins and ablation

There is one leg per pinned behaviour. Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (the anchor must hit once; landing is proven by on-disk counts and a blob change). Each restore is `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`, proven by restored blob equal to the HEAD blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`. No mutation needs a rebuild: every pin imports its subject from `src`.

| leg | mutation (on disk) | reading on the pin file |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A | service-messaging html face encodes verbatim | red, 3 failed of 8: html, mjml, email-channel path. The subject and plain-text pins stay green, as they should |
| B | an unlisted service-messaging file gains an html-named export | red, 1 failed of 8: the outlet-list pin |
| C | plugin-email `renderTemplate` encodes verbatim | red, 32 failed of 66: engine, email-service and every built-in escape pin |
| D | the en-US default footer's app-name hole becomes triple-braced | red, 10 failed of 66: raw-hole placement and escape, for the five en-US templates on that footer |
| E | an unlisted plugin-email file gains an html-named export | red, 1 failed of 66: the outlet-list pin |
| F | approval summary rows stop escaping | red, 2 failed of 5: confirm and result pages |
| G | an unlisted plugin-approvals file gains an html-named export | red, 1 failed of 5: the outlet-list pin |

Legs B, E and G first ran as no-ops: each replacement contained its own anchor, so `ablation-replace` refused the leg as not landed and restored before any test ran. They were re-run with replacements that do not contain the anchor (B2, E2, G2), and the readings above are from those re-runs. All legs ran at `c10cc2a71b`, and every restore was proven.

## Tests and gates (final head `1960b459bb`)

Every run went under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, after the closure build (`pnpm --filter 'PKG^...' --filter PKG build` for the three packages; exit 0).

| command | head | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test` | `1960b459bb` | exit 0, Test Files 55/55, Tests 610/610 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging typecheck` | `1960b459bb` | exit 0; the tsc program lists the new pin file (`--listFiles` count 1) |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test` | `73f7bf8fe5` | exit 0, Test Files 36/36, Tests 643/643 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email typecheck` | `73f7bf8fe5` | exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK`, with 0 errors held and the new file in the test program (count 1) |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test` | `73f7bf8fe5` | exit 0, Test Files 94/94, Tests 1213/1213 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck` | `73f7bf8fe5` | exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK` (ledger unchanged, the new file is in the test program, count 1) |

The only commit after `73f7bf8fe5` is `1960b459bb`, which edits the service-messaging pin file alone. Its package re-ran on that head, and so did the ablation legs that read the file (A and B, again 3/8 and 1/8 red).

**Derived gate families.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 68 commands. All 68 ran, each with its exit captured before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciles **68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (a derived zero: every line records an exit code).
- On the first pass at `73f7bf8fe5`, 65 exited 0.
- `check:engine-double-contract` went red there, because the first draft of the channel-path pin added a new engine double. The pin now hands the channel a stored-row store instead, and the gate is exit 0 at `1960b459bb`.
- `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (prerequisite not met: no full build). After a full build, both are exit 0 at `1960b459bb`.
- The ratchet families were re-run at `1960b459bb`, all exit 0: `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:objectql-double-limit` and `check:nul-bytes`.

The repo-wide scans and the CI-only lanes (Test Core shards, Build Core, the type-check lanes, `test:repo`) are CI's. I did not re-run them locally.

**Dogfood battery:** ~~n/a. The title has no `!` and the claim has no `(narrowing)` arm (see open question 1).~~ Superseded by patch round 1: the claim moved to `(narrowing)`, and the full battery ran on head `7aeddce6f3` (see below).

## Acceptance notes

- The list pin's radius is per package. Each package that holds an outlet today carries its own census, and the census reads only that package's source, so no cross-package input declaration is needed. A new outlet in a package with no list is not seen. The alternatives are in the open questions.
- `service-messaging`'s html face has no unescaped hole by design. The migration line in the changeset names the email-template route for a pre-rendered fragment.
- These new pin files each scan their own package with the `typescript` parser, which is already a devDependency of all three. No gate, script or `turbo.json` entry was added.

## Open questions for the seat

1. **Clause-②: does the html-face escaping count as a narrowing?** It changes what an existing html or mjml `sys_notification_template` row renders when a hole's value carries an ampersand, an angle bracket or a quote. That includes a row that relied on a payload value rendering as markup. Measured reach in this tree at `73f7bf8fe5`:
   - authored html or mjml notification-template rows: 0 (no seed, no example, 0 rows in the dogfood upgrade fixtures `fixture-18.0` and `fixture-18.0.0`, and no `format: 'html'` or `'mjml'` outside `packages/spec`);
   - producers that put pre-rendered HTML into a payload: 0 of the 3 messaging producers (approvals `notify`, the audit mention writer, the automation notify node);
   - rows stored in deployments: not measurable from here.

   The PR is declared `Clause-②: no` as claimed. If the seat amends the claim to `no (narrowing)`, this PR owes a `!` title, a BREAKING changeset with its ADR-0087 disposition, and the full dogfood battery on the final head.
2. **The list pin's radius.** Options:
   - (A) per package, as landed here;
   - (B) one lane-wide census test, which needs a cross-package input declaration in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json`, outside this claim's file surface;
   - (C) a repo-level census in another lane's `repo` vitest project.
3. **One out-of-lane HTML builder** (outside ruling 3C's text-field scope) is named to the seat privately, for the seat to declare cross-lane. Its reach is not measured.

## Patch round 1

- Patch round 1: the changeset now ships as a BREAKING minor (`fix(service-messaging)!`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), head `7aeddce6f3`.
- Full dogfood battery on head `7aeddce6f3`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 286 passed / 3 skipped (289), Tests 2387 passed / 18 skipped (2405), 0 failed.
